_comment: DECLARATIVE default 4-desktop login layout — single source of truth. Captured live from the running KWin/Konsole session on 2026-06-18 (screen 2304x1536, panel 44px → usable 1492px; every split is at the exact half x=1152). Consumed by default-session.nix → default-session-launcher.sh (the engine) + generated Konsole --tabs-from-file files + kwinrulesrc. Edit THIS file to change the layout, never the launcher. Geometry is stored as logical cells (left|right|full); the launcher computes pixels from the LIVE screen geometry at runtime so the layout is resolution-independent and reproducible on any machine.

fallback._comment: Guarantees a crashing/hanging app can NEVER hold the login. The launcher runs as a systemd --user oneshot AFTER graphical-session.target (login is already complete before it starts), each app is spawned detached, and each launch is wrapped in `timeout`. A failed/timed-out launch is logged (and ntfy'd) and the launcher moves on to the next app.
fallback._run_on_doc: WHICH boot type gets the fixed default layout. 'fresh_only' (default): impose this layout ONLY on a FRESH boot — detected by `noresume` on the kernel cmdline, which the rEFInd 'NixOS - Fresh Desktop' entry carries. On a RESTORE boot (rEFInd 'NixOS - Primary', cmdline has resume=) the launcher skips: a real restore resumes the RAM image (no new login happens at all), and the rare cold-fall-through is left to KDE rather than clobbered with the fixed layout. 'always': impose the layout on every login regardless of boot type (the old behaviour).
fallback._position_doc: Positioning re-asserts (desktop + tile) idempotently across several passes so SLOW-to-map windows (e.g. systemsettings under dbus-run-session, electron apps) still get placed. passes × interval should exceed the slowest window's map time.

_apps_doc: App registry — the launcher is GENERIC and reads everything here. To add/change an app you edit ONLY this block + reference it from a desktop window by its key. type=konsole gets the tab/title builder (matched for positioning by PID). For every other app: exec=binary, match_class=KWin resourceClass used to find its window for positioning (case-insensitive), fixed_args=always-passed args, arg_mode=how the window's per-instance value is appended: path→args[0], url→url (single), urls→urls[] (one browser tab per URL), paths→args[] (existing dirs only), none→nothing.

cloud-terminal._doc: Cloud Terminal (Electron, da_cloud-terminal). Launcher on PATH via `build.sh install` → ~/.local/bin. --class sets the Wayland app_id = resourceClass used for positioning.

windows._comment: first 3 tabs auto-run (fish/yazi/plain), then 9 plain shells titled '-'. command runs in the tab's root pane; missing binary falls back to a plain shell.
Cloud Terminal (Electron) — replaces the old konsole-right monitoring pane. Its own multi-tab PTY + profiles (Nix Flakes / Cloud / Tools-DTK) cover the monitoring the konsole tabs were a TODO for.
Default arrangement — keep in sync with da_browser-qute qute-default-window.json (the 'New Default Window' command). tab0 = the bookmark dashboard.
